newsitem.title: ISRAEL: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ISRAEL V CYPRUS WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ISRAEL V CYPRUS WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for World Cup group five qualifier between Israel and Cyprus on Wednesday:

Israel - 1-Rafi Cohen, 2-Alon Harazi, 3-Moshe Glam, 4-Alon Hazan, 5-Amir Shelah, 6-Arik Bennado, 7-Tal Banin, 8-Alon Mizrahi, 9-Eyal Berkovic, 10-Itzik Zohar, 11-Eli Ohana. Substitutes: 12-Assi Domb, 14-Avishai Janno, 15-Reuven Atar, 16-Ran Ben-Shimon, 17-Shai Holtzman, 17-Itzik Kornfein.

Cyprus - 1-Nicos Panayiotou, 2-George Theodotou, 3-Pambos Pittas, 4-Angelos Misos, 5-Marios Charalambous, 6-Neophytos Larkou, 7-Nicos Timotheou, 8-Sozos Andreou, 9-Sinisa Gogic, 10-Costas Malekos, 11-Nick Papavassiliou. Substitutes: 12-Yiotis Engomitis, 13-Yiannos Klotheou, 14-Yiannakis Okkas, 15-Michalis Andreou, 16-Lucas Hadjilucas, 17-Pavlos Marcou, 18-Yiannos Ioannou.
